The *Hetuhetusampayuttaduka* is an Abhidhamma treatise forming section 14.5 of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Within the combinatorial system of the *Paṭṭhāna*, it investigates the operation of conditional relations (*paccaya*) applied specifically to the dyad (*duka*) of root causes (*hetu*) and phenomena associated with root causes (*hetusampayutta*).
